audit_note: A bounded source-backed audit of the exact principal endpoint found no secret-key recovery with fresh signing, reusable equivalent signer, or ordinary-verifier accepted fresh-message forgery. D_MESG length extension is reachable with an attacker-chosen message containing the old glue padding, but it produced a distinct digest, all three Tandem-DM verifiers rejected the unchanged signature, and the LM-OTS checksum argument supplied no signing bridge. Finite scans, one-bit effects, and ranks are defect screens. Generic 2^128 collision/Tandem-DM comparisons, the optimistic 2^118 1,024-target Tandem-DM comparison, and the corrected estimate above 2^236.02 for all forward-computable chain nodes are stopping estimates rather than security lower bounds. The 2^56 and 2^72 fragment enumerations apply only to their named routes and are not lower bounds on full-round cryptanalysis. This is a bounded campaign result, not a security proof.
conformance_limitations: No published or source-independent full K-LMS endpoint known-answer vector.
The paper underdefines the Tandem-DM byte dialect; conclusions apply to the pinned source semantics.
Non-SHA backends reuse RFC typecodes; backend identity remains out of band.
The ordinary verifier has no public-key-length argument, so safe public-key truncation or extension tests cannot be expressed at that API boundary.
Reload evidence is direct-memory and same-process only; durable storage, crash consistency, and atomicity are untested.
Independent primitive KAT, varied hash-API chunking, and fixed padding-vector coverage remain incomplete.
Sanitizer evidence is qualified: host LeakSanitizer is unavailable and the auxiliary paper-LEA core has shift-by-32 UB; selected production backend round trips passed with leak checks disabled.
The Cisco subtree differs from locked upstream in one non-code line-ending file; all 61 C/H files match.
The dual-SHA baseline and expanded SHA/backend matrix were absent from the sealed producer workflow and supplied by the independent review.
Negative controls are reported in aggregate rather than one result row per control.
The paper's 1,169,407 count is an API-event count; the source-supported count is 1,100,799 logical hashes over 62,736,298 logical bytes.
ARIA EVP failures cannot propagate through the void cipher callback; no normal-path failure was observed.

A concrete full-round CHAM, LEA, or ARIA result lowers an exact source-defined Tandem-DM preimage/collision route below 2^45 and supplies an LM-OTS/LMS signing bridge.
An exact KLMS_TDM_PAD_V1 padding/domain alias or a practical same-digest D_MESG length-extension fixed point is demonstrated.
Correct ordinary operation exposes a state, transcript, parser, type, backend, path, or root-binding defect with secret/equivalent signing or an accepted fresh-message forgery.
A concrete secret-derivation, deterministic-C, namespace, or LM-OTS transformation defeats the reviewed separation/checksum arguments below the campaign cutoff.
A material paper or source revision, external endpoint vectors, or new exact-target prior art changes the accepted identity, semantics, or scope.
